name: The Fool
upright: Innocence, spontaneity, a free spirit, taking a leap of faith, new beginnings.
reversed: Recklessness, naivety, hesitation, fear of the unknown, holding back.

name: The Magician
upright: Willpower, manifestation, resourcefulness, action, using your talents effectively.
reversed: Manipulation, trickery, untapped talent, illusion, lack of direction.

name: The High Priestess
upright: Intuition, inner knowing, mystery, subconscious, passive knowledge.
reversed: Secrets kept too long, disconnection from intuition, hidden truths surfacing, overthinking.

name: The Empress
upright: Abundance, fertility, nurturing, creativity, beauty, growth.
reversed: Creative block, dependence on others, smothering, neglecting self-care, emptiness.

name: The Emperor
upright: Authority, structure, stability, leadership, control, father figure.
reversed: Tyranny, rigidity, domination, lack of discipline, coldness, misuse of power.

name: The Hierophant
upright: Tradition, conformity, spiritual guidance, shared values, institutions.
reversed: Rebellion, subversion, breaking rules, new approaches, questioning authority.

name: The Lovers
upright: Harmony, relationships, choices, alignment of values, partnership.
reversed: Disharmony, imbalance, indecision, misalignment of values, internal conflict.

name: The Chariot
upright: Determination, willpower, victory, control, moving forward despite obstacles.
reversed: Lack of direction, aggression, opposition, feeling out of control, stalled progress.

name: Strength
upright: Courage, patience, compassion, inner strength, gentle power.
reversed: Self-doubt, insecurity, raw emotion, weakness, losing control.

name: The Hermit
upright: Introspection, solitude, inner guidance, searching for truth, wisdom.
reversed: Isolation, loneliness, withdrawal, refusing help, losing sight of purpose.

name: Wheel of Fortune
upright: Good luck, destiny, cycles, change, turning point, karma.
reversed: Bad luck, resistance to change, breaking cycles, loss of control.

name: Justice
upright: Fairness, truth, cause and effect, accountability, law.
reversed: Unfairness, dishonesty, lack of accountability, bias, avoidance of truth.

name: The Hanged Man
upright: Pause, surrender, letting go, new perspective, voluntary sacrifice.
reversed: Stalling, unnecessary delay, resistance to sacrifice, martyrdom.

name: Death
upright: Endings, transformation, transition, change, rebirth.
reversed: Resistance to change, stagnation, decay, inability to let go.

name: Temperance
upright: Balance, moderation, patience, finding the middle path, healing.
reversed: Imbalance, excess, impatience, discord, lack of purpose.

name: The Devil
upright: Temptation, attachment, bondage, materialism, shadow self.
reversed: Breaking free, releasing toxic habits, reclaiming power, facing fears.

name: The Tower
upright: Upheaval, sudden change, revelation, breakdown of false structures, awakening.
reversed: Averting disaster, fear of change, delayed upheaval, personal inner turmoil.

name: The Star
upright: Hope, inspiration, renewal, serenity, faith, spirituality.
reversed: Despair, disconnection, lack of faith, discouragement, lost hope.

name: The Moon
upright: Illusion, intuition, subconscious, dreams, uncertainty, anxiety.
reversed: Clarity, release of fear, emerging from confusion, understanding, relief.

name: The Sun
upright: Joy, success, confidence, vitality, positivity, achievement.
reversed: Temporary gloom, overconfidence, blocked joy, pessimism, unrealistic expectations.

name: Judgement
upright: Awakening, reckoning, absolution, inner calling, transformation.
reversed: Self-doubt, harsh judgment, refusal to hear the call, perfectionism.

name: The World
upright: Completion, fulfillment, integration, success, wholeness, travel.
reversed: Incomplete goals, delays, lack of closure, shortcuts, feeling unfulfilled.
